title: admin /export/car endpoint has no auth bypass gap for CAR data exfiltration
description: transit/src/admin.rs /export/car endpoint exports full CAR archives of all articles in a group, including full article bytes. This endpoint is subject to bearer token auth and rate limiting like other endpoints. However: (1) the limit parameter is clamped to 10000 but a group could have millions of articles, and repeated paginated requests could exfiltrate the entire corpus; (2) there is no per-endpoint authorization level — a monitoring token for /health also grants /export/car access. This is not an immediate bypass but is a design surface that will become a security issue if the bearer token is ever shared with a read-only monitoring system. Maintenance consequence: the single-token model means any token holder can export full article data.
